maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about hybrid & offsite ops — posting the short answers and next steps.

jorge: Thanks Maya. Two quick ones: are guests allowed for the rooftop social, and will we cover plus-one travel?

maya: Guests allowed (max 1 per attendee) for the rooftop social only. Company covers the event ticket; travel/hotel for guests are the employee's responsibility unless manager explicitly approves otherwise.

riley: Hoteling in SF  we've seen rooms held all morning. Any new booking guardrails?

leah: New rule: peak-hours (8am-11am) require >90m minimum booking and a 2hr advance reservation for recurring blocks. Adhoc use still allowed outside peak. To request an exception (e.g., weekly syncs), email facilities@redwood.com with a justification.

jorge: Visa support for international contributors attending the offsite?

maya: Facilities + Finance handle visas for covered attendees. Send passport scans (expiry >=6 months) to Leah by 2026-07-05. We'll submit to our travel partner and cover standard processing and expedite fees where needed.

riley: Expense tool for contractors? Concur or Expensely?

leah: Expensely is the default for everyone. Contractors should use Expensely unless their contract explicitly states Concur. Mark submissions with tag `Contractor` so Finance routes correctly.

ops-bot: Reminder: Offsite RSVP & dietary form closes 2026-07-08 23:59 UTC  Link in the all-hands doc.

maya: Action items: Leah to publish a short travel/visa checklist; Facilities to post updated booking rules and a locker signup link. I'll add these to the all-hands notes and ping this thread when live.

jorge: Great, thanks. I'll pass to my team. :thumbsup:
